author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.16.0 — Two small correctness/UX fixes: (1) the 'Mark Rooms as Cleaned' room picker now clears itself after clicking Mark as Cleaned, instead of sitting there looking selected indefinitely; (2) the bin-reminder hour counter can now be corrected directly (a 'Set cumulative hours to' field + button), not just reset to zero -- useful since the polling bug fixed in 1.15.0 could have silently undercounted hours for any session whose transition was missed.
